not_performed: product source, test or specification edits

options_recommended_against.B: a second cross-process configuration guard -- new semantics and deadlock risk for the same outcome
options_recommended_against.C: yielding the lifetime guard -- reopens the second-manager window HOST-8 exists to refuse
options_recommended_against.D: keeping the stop/create/start cycle -- what the FINDING rules out and what OBS-0a forbids as a routine operator step

recommendation: Option A -- a durable creation intent bound to the Job's existing operation id, performed by the SERVING manager inside the guard it already holds. DB-4 prescribes that shape; DB-7 already supplies replay and refusal; HOST-8 untouched.

slices.S1: installer creates and validates every configured path; independently acceptable
slices.S2: install-time idempotent control-store initialisation through the owning API; independently acceptable
slices.S3: status --observe --instance, env var retained; independently acceptable; SEQUENCE AFTER W370555's accepted checkpoint because it touches tools/single_worker.py
slices.S4: Option A; needs the owner's decision first; largest overlap surface, so last

1_create_before_start.anchor: job_manager._create uses ControlStore.open_readonly; the one writable open is _serve
1_create_before_start.kind: code gap under existing DESIGN (OBS-0a, DB-6)
1_create_before_start.refusal: a read-only manager requires an existing regular store

2_missing_workspace_storage.anchor: instance.layout has no workspaces/launch/credentials member and bootstrap creates only stores/repository/logs/state
2_missing_workspace_storage.refusal: the configured workspace store ... is not a directory this manager can see

3_observation_configuration.refusal: this deployment reads its configuration from BATON_V12_STAGE_EXECUTION_CONFIG and it is unset

4_create_while_serving.anchor: creation.py:225 holds the instance guard deliberately so the derivation cannot go stale (DB-3/DB-5); HOST-8 mandates one active manager behind an exclusive non-blocking file lock; borrow_manager_instance composes only in-process
4_create_while_serving.kind: NOT a gap -- a design decision is required
4_create_while_serving.refusal: another manager is already active for workspace ...; stop the active one first

the_four_observed_failures.no_probe_was_run: re-reaching them would require starting the retained instance, which this planning claim forbids
the_four_observed_failures.observed_by: this handler as the operator in W370268; exact refusal text retained in that dossier's evidence/claim-370272
